maker: Hangzhou Fengtan Robot Co., Ltd. (Fulltime Robotics)
name: Fengtan P600 Max multi-function coating robot
summary: Fourth-generation interior coating robot for rooms up to about 6 m that sprays putty, scrapes and sands it, removes dust and sprays paint with quick-change tool heads. Launched by Fengtan (Fulltime Robotics) of Hangzhou in April 2026.

germany.statusNote: No German or EU seller or partner found. The maker in Hangzhou names overseas projects only in Singapore and Hong Kong; no English product page was found.

specs.label: Working height
specs.quote: 专为6米以下建筑涂料施工场景量身打造

specs.label: Processes
specs.value: putty spraying, scraping, sanding, dust removal, paint spraying
specs.quote: 首次以单机实现腻子喷涂、收刮、打磨、吸尘、喷漆五大工序全覆盖

specs.label: Tool control accuracy
specs.value: force ±1 N, position 0.1 mm, speed error 0.5 %
specs.quote: 执行器控制力度精度±1N、位置精度0.1mm、速度精度误差率0.5%

specs.label: Putty scraping flatness
specs.quote: 腻子收刮平整度稳定在0.5mm以内

specs.label: Obstacle height
specs.quote: 越障高度50mm、爬坡能力10°、越沟宽度100mm

specs.label: Navigation
specs.value: 360° lidar, scan-based path planning without drawings

notes: Recognises beams, columns, ceilings, walls and openings from its own 3D scan and plans the work path ("space brain").
The tool mechanism is called a multi-modal actuator; the press text does not say whether it is a robot arm, so arms = 0.
Preorders opened at launch (April 2026); the maker says deliveries for project use started in February 2026.
